summary: Canonical allocation lease identities and complete required-check declarations

delivery.outcome: Generate canonical, schema-valid local allocation leases: derive repositoryRef as owner/repository from an origin URL, or local/<sha256> from the primary checkout when no origin exists; keep the local checkout basename separate for Worktrees v5 layout planning. Resolve the protected publication prerequisite by declaring the already required OneDev context alongside the existing Linux/Windows checks and validating its closed external-provider binding without fabricating a workflow job or weakening hosted job checks.
nonGoals: No migration or mutation of historical malformed leases.
No changes to change-lease schema semantics.
No ticket number or worktree naming changes.
No required check, hosted job, protected registry or live runtime is removed or bypassed.
External-provider declaration is not a test result or publication authority.

architecture.decision: Separate canonical lease repository identity from local filesystem layout label; share the existing URL normalizer and derive clone-local identity through its sibling function. Treat the one existing protected-local OneDev context as an explicitly bound external producer, while preserving exact matching for all hosted jobs.
interfaceChanges: Optional closed externalChecks declaration for onedev/local-verify; existing formats retain their behavior.
architecture.rollback: Revert allocator and regression changes; do not rewrite historical lease records.

validation.evidence: Origin-backed fixture creates owner/repository repositoryRef; layout label remains local.
Origin-less fixture creates local/<sha256>; both generated leases pass canonical change-lease validation.
Ticket changed-file governance passes on the exact implementation scope.
OneDev remains mandatory; unknown/duplicate/provider-mismatched or undeclared external checks and omitted hosted jobs are rejected.
